launches.title: HillStar - Speed to power
launches.tagline: AI that that helps utilities and data centers procure power and equipment
launches.body:
**TL;DR:** HillStar helps utilities and hyperscalers secure power and equipment that operate it faster. Our AI generates and evaluates bids across technical requirements, pricing modeling, and interconnections—with every score linked to source evidence—so buyers can move faster and defend their decisions.\
<https://youtu.be/z-jKEYEEq-g>

**Hi, we’re Nooshin and Kenny (YC W12 & F26).** Nooshin brings two decades of experience delivering utility infrastructure and previously founded Paxon Energy, a utility engineering company. Kenny co-founded PlanGrid (YC W12), which Autodesk acquired for $875 million.

![:zap:](https://a.slack-edge.com/production-standard-emoji-assets/16.0/google-medium/26a1@2x.png)

**The problem**\
Utilities and hyperscalers are competing for the same power projects, cables, and construction crews. A 100 MW grid connection averages \~7 years. Large transformers take 2–4 years to arrive. When capacity and equipment are that scarce, months lost in bid evaluation are years lost on the date power comes on. Such delays increase exposure to equipment costs, tariffs, and market volatility.\
**How it works**

1. **Launch:** Set up and host a solicitation where thousands of power developers submit structured offers.
2. **Evaluate:** AI checks bids against requirements, pricing modeling, permit dashboards, interconnection mapping, flags gaps, and links scores to source documents.
3. **Decide:** Experts review ranked offers and supporting evidence, with an audit trail through the award recommendation.

We’re building toward production-cost simulation to compare resource portfolios under grid constraints and changing market conditions.\
**What HillStar caught**\
In a multibillion-dollar power procurement solicitation involving more than 1,500 developers, HillStar flagged missing mandatory compliance certifications— which could have resulted in a two year delay.

**Our ask**

**Upvote here and like our LinkedIn post: [https://lnkd.in/p/gGyTxGcW](https://lnkd.in/p/gGyTxGcW)**\
Introduce us to utility procurement executives and energy buyers at hyperscalers and data center developers. We’d love to help them on their next power purchase.
